descriptions.zero_spend: Block every paid provider call unless spend is authorised for that run.
descriptions.max_concurrency: Maximum number of tasks the orchestrator runs at the same time.
descriptions.max_tasks_per_agent: Maximum parallel tasks for a single agent.
descriptions.task_timeout_seconds: Wall-clock cap for one task before it is marked as timed out.
descriptions.shell_timeout_seconds: Wall-clock cap for one sandboxed command.
descriptions.max_repairs: Repair attempts before a failing task escalates to a human.
descriptions.sandbox_tier: 1 = subprocess with resource limits, 2 = Docker container per project.
descriptions.decision_confidence_threshold: System-1 confidence needed to act without escalating to System 2.
descriptions.decision_mode: auto | laya | laya_mnn | laya_hosted | local | llm
descriptions.decisions_enabled: Turn the System-1 decision layer off to use only deterministic code rules.
descriptions.guardrail_sensitivity: How aggressively the guardrail layer blocks suspicious model output.
descriptions.auto_approve_low_risk: Allow low-risk actions to proceed without a human click.
descriptions.low_risk_threshold: Risk score below which an action may be auto-approved.
descriptions.compact_mode: Reduce city animation for slower hardware.
descriptions.default_provider_id: Provider used first when an agent has no explicit assignment.
descriptions.fallback_provider_id: Provider used when the primary one fails.
descriptions.plan_token_budget: Token cap for a single plan; hitting it pauses the run.
descriptions.global_token_budget: Token cap across all runs; hitting it pauses the run.
descriptions.approval_timeout_seconds: 0 = wait indefinitely for a human decision.
